errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа пет категории: Видин, Враца, Монтана, Ловеч и Плевен, подредени в произволен ред.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not represent the regions (Видин, Враца, etc.). It represents the years from 2016 to 2020. The regions are the categories represented by the different colored bars within each year's group.
The vertical axis is divided into major intervals of 10%, as shown by the gridlines and labels (0.0, 10.0, 20.0, etc.), not 5%.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стълба, съответстваща на Монтана, е с приблизителна височина 40%
errors.evidence: The lowest bar in the entire chart corresponds to Ловеч (Lovech) in 2020, with a value of approximately 28%, not Монтана (Montana) with a value of 40%.

errors.text_span: докато най-високата стълба, съответстваща на Видин, е с приблизителна височина 55%
errors.evidence: The highest bar in the chart is for Видин (Vidin) in 2017, and its value is approximately 58%, not 55%.
According to the legend, the green color represents Ловеч (Lovech), not Монтана (Montana). Монтана is represented by purple.
The legend indicates that Ловеч (Lovech) is represented by green. There is no light green color in the legend.
According to the legend, Плевен (Pleven) is represented by a light blue/cyan color. The dark blue color represents Видин (Vidin).

The description fails to mention the key structural feature of the chart: that it is a grouped bar chart, where bars for five regions are clustered together for each year on the x-axis. This omission stems from the incorrect interpretation of the axes.
